about: Owner-decided rules and guard limits for LUNAR: War Machines. ONLY an owner-decided prompt may change this file. dev/tests/owner-rules.mjs fails the build when the game code or a guard test drifts from it (a constant changes, a limit is loosened, a CP source or sink appears). Created by the Session 6B prompt (owner decision 9, Nov 16, 2026).

research.about: Owner decision 1 (Session 6B): research costs research parts and time only (no CP, alloy, biomass or helium); Worker clock I 20 min / II 2 h / III 8 h; one job at a time, a second slot at Science Lab III; the lab stays max level 3, built from CC3.

guards.what: CC timelines within ±10% of the audit table
no instant max-out: CC10 never inside the first week

cpSites.about: every line that adds to or takes from a pilot's CP (ledger.cp or ledger['cp'] with =, +=, -=, *=, /=, ++, --; .cp += / -= / ++ / --) and every debit( call. A new CP source or sink is an owner decision.

lint.about: code swallowed by a // comment never runs (the wall-storage bug, three dead test checks): none allowed

computed.about: owner-rules runs these guard tests itself and judges their own outputs against these limits, so loosening a test's asserts cannot pass
